stringUnit.value: You're the captain, so you sign for your team.
你是队长，由你代表本队签署。
Only the captain can act. You can follow along here.
仅当前队长可操作，你可以在这里查看进度。
Signing is closed right now. You can still see the current status.
现在不能签署，仍可查看当前状态。
Plan actions aren't open yet. View only for now.
操作信息尚未更新，当前只读
The result isn't confirmed yet. Even if you leave or restart, the app checks this same action and never sends it twice.
结果待确认。离开或重启后仍会核对这一次操作，不会重复提交。
A pledge, a pick or locked materials don't mean the plan has run yet. The latest status is below.
投入意向、选定或锁定物资都不代表方案已执行，以下方最新状态为准。
Locked materials (trade or plan locks) stay in your backpack and still count toward its weight.
锁定的物资（交易锁或方案锁）仍在背包里，照常计入负重
Your team's pledge (only your team sees it): %@
Your captain has locked in the pledge.
本队当前队长已确认托管
Your captain signed the pledge; it isn't locked in yet.
本队当前队长已签署意向，尚未托管
Your team hasn't pledged anything yet.
The captain changed, so the old signature no longer counts. The current captain needs to sign again.
队长已变更，旧意向签名失效，请由当前队长重新签署
Enter a whole number from 0 to 999 for each. All zeros clears your team's pledge; it doesn't withdraw the plan.
每项填 0–999 的整数；全部填 0 会清空本队投入，不会撤回整个方案。
Materials are used only after the task passes. The confirmed record decides the result.
操作通过后才会消耗已确认物资，结果以确认的操作记录为准。
The captain changed; needs a new signature
队长已变更，须重新签署
Whether it counts depends on the current stage.
是否生效以当前阶段为准。
Your captain signed to reject all remaining plans.
本队队长已签署拒绝全部剩余方案。
Pick as many as you like, or none. Submitting is signed again by the current captain.
可选择多个，也可不接受任何方案；提交会由当前队长重新签署。
Shared task done. The story continues.
共同操作完成，继续剧情
When you confirm, the app checks the captain and the plan again. If anything changed, you'll need to confirm again.
确认时会再次核对队长和方案状态；如有变化，需要重新确认。
You're accepting no plans this time.
Wrapping up with the default ending
Majority wins · accept round if stuck
多数通过 · 接受轮恢复
This task needs a started plan and your team's access. An expired task can't be submitted.
需要已开始的方案和本队的玩法权限；已过期的任务不能提交。
Confirm and lock your team's materials
The current captain signs the pledge. No materials are locked or used yet.
意向由当前队长签署，不会锁定或消耗物资。
Locks only the materials in your team's pledge. Locking in doesn't carry out the plan.
只锁定本队意向里的物资；托管不等于方案已执行。
Changing the plan releases plan-locked materials and this round's votes and signatures. Trade-locked materials stay locked. Every team needs to check again.
改案只释放方案锁定的物资和本轮投票、签名；交易锁定的物资不会释放。所有队伍需要重新确认。
This affects the current plans, round and signatures, on behalf of your team's current captain.
这次操作会影响当前方案、票轮与签名，仅代表本队当前队长。
The plan runs only after every team's signature, locked materials, the task pass and costs are confirmed. Selected doesn't mean carried out.
各队签名、托管物资、操作任务通过和费用都确认后才会结算。选定不等于已执行。
Starting opens the task. You still need to complete it to pass.
开始只是开启操作任务，仍需完成任务才算通过。
Cancels your team's task and its proof. The plan isn't carried out and nothing is refunded automatically.
取消本队当前的方案操作及其证明；不会执行方案，也不会自动退款。
Signed by the current captain for this round. The confirmed result decides.
由当前队长按本轮签署，结果以确认的操作记录为准。
Another action in this game is still waiting for its result. Check it where you started it.
本局还有一个操作在等待结果，请回到发起的地方确认。
Result checked. New actions aren't open yet.
已确认操作结果，暂未开放新的操作。
That action didn't go through. Nothing was resent.
这次操作未成功，没有重复提交。
Plan carried out. The latest result is below.
方案已执行，最新结果见下方。
Done. Proposing, pledging, voting, selecting and locking in don't carry out the plan yet.
操作已完成。提出、意向、投票、选定和托管都不等于方案已执行。
The result isn't confirmed yet. The app keeps checking this same action and never sends it twice.
结果待确认，请刷新后再试。不会自动重复提交。
Another action in this game is still waiting for its result. Finish it where you started it.
本局还有一个操作在等待结果，请回到发起的地方处理。
Couldn't save this action safely on your device, so it wasn't sent. Try again.
无法在本机安全记录这次操作，未提交，请重试。
Your team, captain or round changed. Refresh and check again; the action wasn't counted.
状态已变化，请刷新后重新确认；本次操作未生效。
%@ will appear on the template shelf, where others can copy it as a starting draft.
%@会出现在主题模板货架上，其他人可以复制它作为草稿起点。
This topic will appear on the template shelf, where others can copy it as a starting draft.
「这个主题」会出现在主题模板货架上，其他人可以复制它作为草稿起点。

This only says whether a lookup is possible; it doesn't prove there's no chargeback. Nothing is looked up from here.
这一项只说明能否查询，不代表没有拒付；这里不会发起查询。
This record hasn't been looked up yet.
这条记录还没有查询过。
No refunds or chargebacks yet. This doesn't mean a refund request was approved.
暂无退款或拒付记录。这不代表退款申请已获批准。
This only shows records. In progress, unknown or not yet read doesn't mean refunded. No refund is started from here.
这里只显示记录。处理中、未知或尚未读到结果都不等于退款成功；这里不会发起退款。
Refund status can't be read right now; that doesn't mean there's no refund. License details are still shown.
暂时读不到退款状态，不代表没有退款。许可详情仍可查看。

已取得本人的操作结果
Your result isn't confirmed yet. What's shown now doesn't replace it.
结果待确认，当前显示不代替你的操作结果
